title: Sephiria Destiny Inscription: Upgrade Paths and Talents
description: Use the Destiny Inscription tree to unlock village systems, weapons, and talents, and check prerequisites before spending sapphires.
meta: Updated 26 October 2026. Progression reference based on the Steam Basic Guide; confirm node names and requirements in your current game.
body:
Destiny Inscription is Sephiria’s permanent meta tree. Sapphires come from dungeon depth and bosses defeated; spending them unlocks weapons, events, inventory, dice, and talent access. Use the board’s links to inspect prerequisites and choose upgrades based on the next system or weapon you want to unlock.

How the tree is organized

  • New Events / fruit skewers lines — unlock systems you will use every run.
  • Home Repairs — progresses village quests and opens Talents (talk to the relevant NPCs after unlocking).
  • Weapon training nodes — required before Morrow’s training grounds grant new weapons.
  • Hard Mode access — after Chapter II, talk to the village tree and pick the Hard Mode dialogue (current path). Older “free Destiny node” text is outdated; see the Hard Mode unlock page.

Spend decision guide

Your next goalInspect on the treeConfirm before spending
Open a town systemNew Events branchRead the node description and check whether it unlocks the Wishing Fountain or another town feature.
Practice a weaponWeapon training nodesCheck both the tree prerequisite and any follow-up training-ground quest.
Improve an existing buildTalent nodes after Home RepairsMatch the talent to your chosen weapon, and confirm the current respec method in the client.

Early spend order

  1. New Events lines — daily-use systems first.
  2. Home Repairs until Talents open.
  3. Weapon training for the weapon you are learning.
  4. Talents matching that weapon — respec is allowed, so early picks are not permanent.

Talents

Once unlocked, talent points let you bias defense, MP regen, Willpower (luck-like outcomes), dash windows, and more. Guides agree you can respec—use that to match the weapon you are learning (weapons).

Version boundary: the Steam Basic Guide's main Destiny tree section is based on version 0.7.31, with some 0.7.35 updates and a later author comment correcting the Hard Mode unlock. Its exact counts and node details are not a complete 1.0+ tree map; verify names, costs, and prerequisites in the current board.

Quick FAQ

Where do sapphires come from?
Dungeon depth and bosses defeated — they accrue across runs, so early misses are cheap to recover.

Can you respec?
Yes — guides agree you can respec; match talents to the weapon you are learning.

Is Hard Mode a Destiny node?
Not anymore — the unlock moved to the village tree dialogue in 0.7.55 (see Root’s Retreat).
